description: Find runnable SBGrid3.0 code examples by feature or use case. Returns ready-to-adapt example snippets. Use when you want working sample code rather than the API reference. [Regular grid only — SBGrid3.createGrid: row lists, editing, sorting, filtering, grouping, paging, excel. If the requirement is a PIVOT / cross-tab summary (rows x columns x aggregated values), use the SBPivot tools (searchSBPivotAPI etc.) instead — it is a different grid.] ⚠️ SBGrid3 코드/샘플 생성 시 서버 공통지침(요청 범위의 제품 기능 우선 · 표준 골격과 columns/gridConfig 명시 · HTML 병행 이유 설명 · 불필요한 기능 추가 금지) 준수 — 상세는 서버 instructions 참고.

limit.description: Maximum number of examples to return. Default 3.

query.description: Feature or use case to find examples for (e.g. 'excel export', 'row grouping', 'cell editing').

name: getSBGridExample
